scope.summary: Author the masc/fem continuum channel per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-052), following the Genesis-9 single-unimesh pattern and the beyond-parity cross-blend finding: masc_fem_continuum exposes gender as a continuous axis over the ONE base mesh (no separate male/female meshes), supporting unrestricted cross-sex channel stacking including futa builds (archetype h groundwork; genital module coexistence lands in 13.21).
acceptance_criteria: masc_fem_continuum registered as a Tissue channel with multi-key tracks spanning the full continuum (sculpted keys at least at fem-pole, neutral, masc-pole positions) over a declared whole-body-silhouette mask that EXCLUDES breast, glute, and genital masks (those regions are governed by their own channels).

Cross-stacking proof: masc_fem_continuum at masc pole + breast_volume 3.0 evaluates without conflict (channels compose; no code path zeroes breast channels based on continuum value) — the archetype (h) groundwork test.
Continuum sweeps pass BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID against the declared mask (zero writes into breast/glute/genital masks).
No male/female base mesh switch exists anywhere in the code (negative test: single base_mesh_version path).
Channel is API-addressable; registry row documents the continuum semantics and pole definitions.
scope.risk_if_missed: Separate male/female bases double every downstream asset (the Genesis 2 lesson) and hard-block futa builds; a continuum that internally zeroes cross-sex channels would make archetype (h) — a market-required build — unreachable.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
